vessel.label: Vessel

persona.label: Persona
persona.description: An action, spell or ability with the persona trait can only be used while you are in your persona form. Ongoing effects created by a persona effect immediately end if you return to shadow form.

latent.label: Latent
latent.description: An action or ability with the latent trait can only be used while you are in your shadow form. Ongoing effects created by a latent effect immediately end if you return to persona form.

duality.label: Duality
duality.description: A Vessel class feat that grants benefits related to both your persona and shadow forms.
